title: manage mcp servers / Control or remove a server
content: ## Control or remove a server In **MCP Servers** in the [Agent Customizations editor](#open-the-server-controls), open the server's ellipsis (**...**) menu and choose an available action. Alternatively, run **MCP: List Servers** from the Command Palette, select the server, and choose an available action. | Action | When to use it | |--------|----------------| | **Start Server** | Start a configured server. | | **Stop Server** | End the current run. A later request can start the server again. | | **Restart Server** | Restart after changing configuration or resolving a problem. If this action isn't offered, stop the server and then start it again. | | **Enable** or **Disable** | Control availability without deleting the configuration. | | **Uninstall** | Remove a server you no longer need. | Starting can require trust or authentication. If the server fails to start, [view its output](#view-server-output) before retrying. **Disabling is different from stopping.** A disabled server doesn't start, and its tools, resources, prompts, and MCP apps are unavailable. Use the toggle beside the server, or select an enablement action from its menu to choose a scope. Depending on the server and harness, global, workspace, or session scope is available. The enabled state is separate from shared configuration, so disabling a server doesn't change your teammates' configuration. **Removal depends on the configuration source.** If **Uninstall** isn't available for a manually configured server, remove only its entry from the source configuration, not the whole file. If automatic discovery restores it, review its [discovery source](/docs/agents/reference/mcp-configuration.md#automatic-mcp-server-discovery). You can also uninstall an installed server from the **MCP SERVERS - INSTALLED** section of the Extensions view. For {% data variables.product.prodname_github %}-managed MCP servers, [disconnect the {% data variables.product.prodname_copilot_short %} connector](/docs/agent-customization/copilot-connectors.md#disconnect-a-service) instead of uninstalling a server or editing a local configuration file.
